evals.name: release-0.1.17-big
evals.prompt: prepare the changelog for release 0.1.17: turn Unreleased into the release section, write the Play what's new and the media shot list
evals.expected_output: A ## [0.1.17] section in the chosen format covering the 38 commits since v0.1.16 that a person notices, a plain-text Play note under 500 characters, and a shot list with one still and one clip per headline.
assertions: check_changelog.py passes on the produced section (media files aside)
play.txt is at most 500 characters and plain text
every tip label exists in app/lib of that clone
no bullet without a surviving feat/fix/perf commit
shot list names one still and one clip per headline, named <version>-<slug>
